line.text: 各位同學，當我坐在旋轉椅上翻轉這個車輪，角動量守恆會發生什麼事？
line.after: Right after the line the speaker's lips close naturally and stay closed.

At 0.25 seconds, he speaks his question with an enthusiastic smile and natural lip movements. Right after the question finishes, his lips close naturally and stay closed, and he looks attentively out toward the students with a warm smile waiting for an answer. line.text: 老師不要點我……我只知道期中考我會頭很暈……
line.after: Right after the line the speaker's lips close naturally and stay closed.

shots.action: Yu sits in the front row of the tiered amphitheater desks, clutching his General Physics textbook tightly against his chest with both hands. At 0.25 seconds, he speaks his anxious line with comical guilty lip movement and a pleading, timid smile trying to hide from the professor's gaze. Right after finishing his line, his lips close naturally and stay closed, breathing a small quiet sigh. High shutter speed, zero motion blur.

Prof. Chang sits on the chrome swivel demonstration stool and tilts the spinning bicycle wheel sideways. The stool immediately begins rotating, carrying the professor in a smooth 360-degree spin. Throughout the entire shot, he keeps his mouth completely closed in a broad, excited closed-mouth grin, lips firmly shut without any mumbling or lip movement, keeping his glasses and face sharp. High shutter speed cinematography, crisp rotational motion, zero blur, no ghosting.

line.text: 看到了嗎？這就是物理學的魔力！大家精神都來了吧！
line.after: Right after the line the speaker's lips close naturally and stay closed.

shots.action: On the lecture platform, Prof. Chang safely brings the swivel stool to a steady stop. At 0.25 seconds, he speaks his triumphant line with clear lip synchronization while pushing up his glasses. Right after his speech finishes, his lips close naturally into a proud, smiling expression and stay closed. In the foreground, Yu puts down his textbook, laughing out loud with a wide open joyful laugh and clapping his hands enthusiastically. High shutter speed, clear classroom atmosphere, zero ghosting.
